usage: sot-validator reclaim-ports [-h] [--snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                   [--output OUTPUT_FILE] [--db-path DB_PATH]
                                   [--streaks-json STREAKS_JSON] [--lldp-json LLDP_JSON]
                                   [--snmp-fixture SNMP_FIXTURE] [--dialect {exos,voss}]
                                   [--min-inactive-runs MIN_INACTIVE_RUNS]
                                   [--min-inactive-days MIN_INACTIVE_DAYS]
                                   [--evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME]
                                   [--site-ids SITE_IDS [SITE_IDS ...]] [--all-sites]
                                   [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE] [--rate-limit RATE_LIMIT]
                                   [--no-resume] [--fixtures] [--num-sites NUM_SITES]
                                   [--fixture-path FIXTURE_PATH] [--sql-dump SQL_DUMP]
                                   [--sqlite-path SQLITE_PATH] [--csv-dir CSV_DIR]
                                   [--json-export JSON_EXPORT] [--scrape-url SCRAPE_URL]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR
                        Directory containing extracted site snapshots.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Directory to write port_reclamation_plan.json and EXOS/VOSS CLI scripts
                        (default: ./reports).
  --output, --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                        Optional custom path for port_reclamation_plan.json.
  --db-path, --history-db DB_PATH
                        Optional HistoryStore SQLite DB or JSON file for port inactivity streaks.
  --streaks-json STREAKS_JSON
                        Optional JSON file containing streak summaries or history_summary.json.
  --lldp-json LLDP_JSON
                        Optional JSON file containing LLDP/CDP neighbor observations.
  --snmp-fixture SNMP_FIXTURE
                        Optional SNMP discovery fixture JSON file.
  --dialect {exos,voss}
                        Primary Extreme CLI dialect for script generation (default: exos).
  --min-inactive-runs MIN_INACTIVE_RUNS
                        Minimum consecutive inactive runs required for port reclamation (default:
                        3).
  --min-inactive-days MIN_INACTIVE_DAYS
                        Minimum inactive duration in days required for port reclamation (default:
                        30.0).
  --evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME
                        Optional reference ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.
  --site-ids SITE_IDS [SITE_IDS ...]
                        Target site IDs (comma-separated or space-separated, e.g.
                        site-001,site-002).
  --all-sites           Process all available sites.
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
                        Number of sites per extraction batch (default: 10).
  --rate-limit RATE_LIMIT
                        Polite delay in seconds between per-site requests (default: 0.0).
  --no-resume           Disable checkpoint resume and re-extract all target sites.
  --fixtures            Use deterministic built-in FixtureSoTClient inventory.
  --num-sites NUM_SITES
                        Number of fixture sites to generate when --fixtures is set (default: 3).
  --fixture-path FIXTURE_PATH
                        Path to a JSON fixture file for FixtureSoTClient.
  --sql-dump SQL_DUMP   Path to a read-only SQL dump file (.sql).
  --sqlite-path SQLITE_PATH
                        Path to a read-only SQLite database export.
  --csv-dir CSV_DIR     Path to a directory containing SoT CSV export tables.
  --json-export JSON_EXPORT
                        Path to a JSON export file of SoT tables or sites.
  --scrape-url SCRAPE_URL
                        Base URL for read-only GET HTML scraping of the legacy SoT.
